verdict.rationale: Xero publishes an official developer portal with SDKs (e.g. xero-node), official OpenAPI specs, and an AI Toolkit including an official MCP server, LangChain integration, and OpenAI Agents SDK support, giving AI-native builders concrete official SDK/tooling to build against. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK quality or broader language-SDK coverage beyond JS, and llms.txt probe returned 404.
